from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single 2025 Q1 company report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if available in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period (e.g., 2025 Q1)")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders in CNY")
    total_assets_at_period_end: float | None = Field(description="Total assets at the end of the period in CNY")
    net_operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities in CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
